character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After surviving Commander Vance's ambush and plunging into a deep subterranean shaft, Kael found himself paralyzed by a remote lockdown trap on a cavern ledge. Pushing past the neural override by channeling his glowing amber energy, Kael shattered the paralysis and destroyed the console. Now trapped together underground with no escape, Kael and Vance face each other in a final, desperate showdown.
